description: Single-panel line plot of a thermodynamic solidification calculation (no micrographs or photographs). The x-axis is z_s (solidification fraction) spanning 0.70-0.90 with gridline ticks at 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90; the y-axis is labelled "logK_MnS & logQ_MnS" spanning -0.25 to 0.50 with ticks at -0.25, 0.00, 0.25, 0.50 (background is a cosmetic light-cyan gradient). The legend defines six curves: logK (1#), logQ (1#), logK (2#), logQ (2#), logK (3#), logQ (3#), with solid lines for logK and dashed lines for logQ, colour-coded black = sample 1#, blue = sample 2#, red = sample 3#. The three solid logK_MnS curves decrease monotonically as z_s rises; the 1# and 2# curves lie between the 0.00 and 0.25 gridlines at z_s = 0.70, while 3# starts above the 0.25 gridline. The three dashed logQ_MnS relations are straight, upward-sloping lines. Each logK curve crosses its matching logQ line once, marked by a filled circle and annotated with the z_s value: 0.77 (1#), black circle; 0.81 (2#), blue circle; 0.85 (3#), red circle. The intersection therefore shifts to higher z_s and higher y-value (the 3# circle sits essentially on the 0.25 gridline) as sample number increases, demonstrating that MnS precipitation is delayed to a larger solidification fraction at higher Al content.

subfigures.description: Line plot of logK_MnS (solid) and logQ_MnS (dashed) versus z_s = 0.70-0.90, with three colour-coded sample pairs (black 1#, blue 2#, red 3#). Filled circles mark the logK = logQ intersections, annotated 0.77 (1#), 0.81 (2#) and 0.85 (3#).

observations.observation: The plot overlays two y-quantities, logK_MnS and logQ_MnS, against x = z_s ranging from 0.70 to 0.90, with the y-axis spanning -0.25 to 0.50.
The legend uses solid lines for logK and dashed lines for logQ, with colour coding black = 1#, blue = 2#, red = 3#.
Three filled circles mark the intersections of each logK_MnS curve with its matching logQ_MnS line, annotated with the printed z_s values 0.77 (1#), 0.81 (2#) and 0.85 (3#).
The logK_MnS curves decrease monotonically with increasing z_s, whereas the logQ_MnS relations are straight upward-sloping lines, so each pair has exactly one crossing in the plotted window.
The intersection for sample 3# lies at the highest z_s and at a higher y-value (essentially on the 0.25 gridline) than the 1# and 2# intersections.
The figure is titled as the relationship among logK_MnS, logQ_MnS and z_s.
The caption states that the solidification fractions of MnS inclusions precipitated in samples 1# to 3# are 0.77, 0.81 and 0.85, respectively, matching the three annotated intersection points.
The citing text states that increasing Al content leads to a delay in the solidification fraction of MnS inclusion precipitation.

The citing text states that when the Al content increases from 1% to 5%, the solidification fraction of MnS inclusion precipitation changes (the sentence is truncated in the supplied text, so the final value is not available).
No numeric y-values (logK_MnS or logQ_MnS magnitudes) are printed anywhere on the plot; only the z_s intersection values are annotated.
